theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_rh_mc_tendsto_integral_of_uniform
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (K : Set (Euclidean N)) (F : ℕ → Euclidean N → ℝ) (G : Euclidean N → ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → IsCompact K → (∀ k, Integrable (F k) μ) → Integrable G μ → (∀ k, ∀ y ∉ K, F k y = G y) → (∀ ε > 0, ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ∀ y, |F k y - G y| ≤ ε) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y, F k y ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, G y ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
